title: GDP and Economic Diversification
question: Which sectors account for output and how has real GDP changed?
source: NBS GDP tables; World Bank WDI national preview
kpi: Sector shares and real GDP growth
caveat: Do not splice GDP vintages or confuse nominal value added shares with real growth.

title: Growth and Household Welfare
question: Do growth and household welfare improve together?
kpi: Real consumption per adult equivalent; poverty headcount
caveat: Respect survey design and attrition. Match welfare waves and GDP vintages.

title: Food Prices and Purchasing Power
question: Which state food baskets have the highest cost increases?
kpi: Fixed-basket cost and year-on-year food-price change
caveat: Keep product specifications, physical quantities and units constant.

title: Petrol and Transport Costs
question: How do fuel and passenger-fare changes co-move?
source: NBS Petrol Price Watch and Transport Fare Watch
kpi: NGN per litre; fare by transport mode
caveat: Align state-month-mode keys. Price co-movement does not identify subsidy effects.

title: Security and Civilian Exposure
question: How does reported violence vary across states and months?
kpi: Reported incidents; reported fatalities; exposed population
caveat: Requires authorised ACLED data. Document sourcing changes; counts are not all crime.

title: Insecurity and Agricultural Activity
question: Are cultivation and harvest outcomes associated with conflict exposure?
kpi: Harvest per hectare and conflict exposure
caveat: Geospatial displacement, reporting bias and confounding prevent simple causal claims.

title: Security and Business Constraints
question: Which constraints are reported by households and enterprises?
kpi: Weighted share reporting each constraint
caveat: Survey opinions and business measurements are distinct populations. Do not join respondent records across surveys.

title: Crop Production and Yield
question: Does production growth reflect higher yields or cultivated-area expansion?
kpi: Tonnes; hectares; kilograms per hectare
caveat: WDI preview covers cereals only, not all Nigerian crops. FAOSTAT crop-level decomposition remains pending.

title: Inputs Irrigation and Productivity
question: How do crop yields vary with irrigation and input use?
kpi: Yield by irrigation and input category
caveat: Convert harvest and area units; retain crop-specific denominators and survey weights.

title: Storage and Market Access
question: Which communities lack agricultural storage and market access?
kpi: Reported storage access; travel time to market
caveat: Confirm actual questionnaire variables before deriving an indicator. Do not infer cold storage from generic storage.

title: Rural Infrastructure and Welfare
question: How do service access and welfare differ across rural communities?
kpi: Weighted access proportions; real consumption
caveat: GHS-Panel supports national and zone estimates; do not assume state representativeness.

title: Electricity and Economic Opportunity
question: How does electricity access relate to work and enterprise activity?
kpi: Access proportion; reliability; enterprise outcomes
caveat: National WDI access does not measure reliability or identify enterprise effects.

title: Water Sanitation and Inequality
question: Who lacks basic water and sanitation services?
kpi: Basic water and sanitation access
caveat: National estimates cannot produce state or wealth-group inequalities. Survey extensions remain pending.

indicators.SH.H2O.BASW.ZS: At least basic drinking water (% population)

title: Government Policy and Approval
question: How do Nigerians assess policies and government performance?
kpi: Weighted approval by policy and demographic group
caveat: Verify question wording, coding, eligible denominator and sample design; approval is not policy impact.

title: Public Mood and Confidence
question: How do Nigerians assess the economy and country direction?
kpi: Weighted positive response proportion by question and round
caveat: Survey attitudes are not a clinical mood score. Harmonise questions and response codes across rounds.

title: Road Crashes across States
question: Which states record the highest crash burden and severity?
kpi: Crashes; deaths; injuries; deaths per 100 crashes
caveat: Population rates are not travel-exposure rates. Counts depend on reporting and road usage.

title: Road Crash Seasonality
question: Which observed periods have unusually high crash counts?
kpi: Quarterly crashes and same-quarter annual change
caveat: Quarterly totals do not reveal dangerous hours or weekdays. Event timestamps are required for finer timing.

title: Crash Severity and Contributing Factors
question: How do reported factors relate to crash severity?
kpi: Fatal crashes / crashes by factor when available
caveat: Aggregate factor counts may overlap and may not be joined to severity. No factor-specific risk without compatible records.

title: Healthcare and Financial Barriers
question: Who experiences financial barriers to healthcare?
source: GHS-Panel health; NDHS; WDI financing preview
kpi: Reported unmet need; out-of-pocket share
caveat: WDI financing share is not the percentage of households with catastrophic expenditure.

title: Maternal and Child Healthcare
question: Where are maternal-care and child-vaccination gaps largest?
kpi: Skilled birth attendance; child immunisation
caveat: WDI national trends do not fulfil state or demographic inequalities; denominator populations differ by indicator.

indicators.SH.STA.BRTC.ZS: Births attended by skilled health staff (% total)
